sections.h2: PLI scheme drew 26% more investment than its approved outlay

chart.title: PLI investment attracted exceeds the approved outlay by about a quarter
chart.sub: Cumulative across 14 sectors, as of 31 March 2026, ₹ lakh crore.
chart.source: Government of India, as compiled in press coverage (Business Standard, A2Z Taxcorp, The Hawk).

sections.means: The PLI scheme has attracted ₹2.40 lakh crore of investment against an approved outlay of ₹1.91 lakh crore, and its three biggest sectors by investment are all goods-manufacturing categories.
sections.todo: Compare the PLI and Export Promotion Mission results against a services-side instrument before treating goods support as the default.

sections.h2: Services exports outgrew goods in H1 FY26, 6.5% against 2.4%

chart.title: Services grew faster than merchandise exports in the same half-year
chart.sub: Export growth, H1 FY26 against the same period a year earlier, %.
chart.source: Economic Survey 2025-26, as summarised by IBEF, Insights on India and India Briefing.

sections.means: Services exports grew 6.5% in H1 FY26 while merchandise exports grew only 2.4% despite higher US tariffs, so the growth is in services even though the policy support is aimed at goods.
sections.todo: Look for a services-specific export instrument of comparable scale to the Export Promotion Mission, which this piece did not find.

sections.h2: The India-EU FTA gives immediate duty elimination on 90.7% of India's export value

chart.title: Immediate duty elimination covers most of India's export value
chart.sub: Share of India's exports by value under the India-EU FTA, %.
chart.source: Ministry of Commerce & Industry release of 27 January 2026, as reported by KPMG, Lexology and Bajaj Finserv.

sections.means: The FTA covers 99.5% of India's exports by value and eliminates duty immediately on 90.7%, concentrated in textiles, leather, footwear, marine products and gems and jewellery.
sections.todo: Track how much of the immediate duty elimination reaches the smaller exporters the Export Promotion Mission targets.
